test_cases.title: A customer submits an order and the admin declines it, leaving no order behind
acs: DERIVED: SUBMIT with the terms accepted sends the order to Review Pending Orders and returns the customer to Home; an admin Decline removes the order and its schemes (PendingContractOrder.aspx.vb BtnSubmit_Click; Contracts Admin PendingContractOrder.aspx.vb ButtonDecline_Click)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user (customer QAL/0432). The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 with Windows identity dt2\ns000134.

Repeatable: before the test and in its cleanup, any submitted order of QAL/0432 is declined in a separate admin browser, which deletes the order and its pending schemes. No database restore is needed.
Cleanup also deselects the scheme the test selected, even when the test fails.
Decline sends notification emails; the local mail server at localhost:5615 may be absent.

steps.action: As admin, open Manage Contracts > Review Pending Orders and decline any order for QAL/0432.
steps.expected: No order for QAL/0432 is waiting for review.

steps.action: As the customer, open http://localhost:1688/PendingContractOrder.aspx?year=current and tick the last scheme that has a month available to order.
steps.expected: The scheme and its months are ticked.

steps.action: Click Next, tick the terms and conditions and any consent declarations shown.
steps.expected: The Pending Order summary is shown and SUBMIT is enabled.
The customer is returned to Home.

steps.action: As admin, open Review Pending Orders.
steps.expected: An order for QAL/0432 is listed.

steps.action: Open the order with Details and click Decline.
steps.expected: The order is removed from the list.

steps.action: As the customer, open the order page again.
steps.expected: A new order starts with no scheme selected and Next disabled.

test_cases.title: Next stays disabled while no scheme is selected
acs: DERIVED: Next is disabled until a selected scheme has a month available to order (PendingContractOrder.aspx.vb NextButtonEnabled)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user (customer QAL/0432). The database has a backup.
Cleanup: the test deselects the scheme it selected, even when it fails. The order is never submitted.
Before the check, the test deselects any scheme left selected on the draft order.

steps.expected: The Create New Order page opens.

steps.action: Untick every scheme that is ticked and enabled.
steps.expected: No scheme is selected.
The page finishes updating.
Next is disabled.

steps.action: Do not click any other button.
steps.expected: Nothing else changes.

acs: DERIVED: Unticking the only selected scheme removes it from the draft order and disables Next (PendingContractOrder.aspx.vb Check_Clicked, NextButtonEnabled)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user (customer QAL/0432). The database has a backup.
